content.text:
The member at the front of the hold queue can now check the item out, and members queued behind them no longer stop that checkout. All 61 tests pass, including the existing ones.

**Cause:** `findBlockingHold` in `lib/holds/queue.js` returned any active hold belonging to another member. So a front member with someone queued behind them was told the item was held for someone else.

**Fix:** The function now looks only at the front of the queue, using the same ordering as `holdQueue`. It blocks everyone except the member at the front, and it returns `null` when nobody is queued. A member who is queued but not at the front is still refused with `on-hold`.

**Test:** I added one to `test/checkout.test.js` with two queued members. The front member checks out, and the member behind them is refused with `on-hold`.

Two earlier tool calls were blocked, so I made the edits with the file tools instead. Nothing is committed.
